# Env packages on Linux (read by setup). The dists and the SDL3 overlay for development builds get
# SDL3, SDL3_image, SDL3_ttf and Python from the env recipes, so they have the same versions as on
# macOS, and everything else from the system (Ubuntu 24.04 is the baseline).
#
# [build]: the packages setup builds (with their dependencies) when run without arguments. The
# order does not matter: each recipe builds its dependencies first.
# [system]: packages the system provides. They are never built, and a recipe's dependency on one
# does nothing; the system's development package must be installed instead (in comments below,
# for Ubuntu 24.04).

[build]
python
sdl3
sdl3_image
sdl3_ttf

[system]
flac                # libflac-dev
freetype            # libfreetype-dev
freetype-noharfbuzz # libfreetype-dev
gettext             # part of glibc
glib                # libglib2.0-dev
harfbuzz            # libharfbuzz-dev
libffi              # libffi-dev
libiconv            # part of glibc
libmpeg2            # libmpeg2-4-dev
libpng              # libpng-dev
libsamplerate       # libsamplerate0-dev
libuuid             # uuid-dev
mpg123              # libmpg123-dev
openssl             # libssl-dev
portmidi            # libportmidi-dev
sqlite              # libsqlite3-dev
xz                  # liblzma-dev
zlib                # zlib1g-dev
zstd                # libzstd-dev
